title: G1 Walk, Grab, Return
brief: Preview the complete scripted Unitree G1 walk, fixed-hand grab, and return sequence.
starterPython:
robot.home()
robot.set_posture("wide_stance", seconds=0.8)
robot.walk("forward", steps=3, step_length=0.08, speed=45)
robot.set_posture("work_reach", seconds=0.8)
robot.pick_nearest("right_hand")
robot.set_posture("wide_stance", seconds=0.8)
robot.turn(180, seconds=1.4)
robot.walk("forward", steps=3, step_length=0.08, speed=45)
robot.release("right_hand")
robot.home()
successCriteria: uses only Unitree G1 manifest joint, posture, and hand identifiers
uses finite scripted steps and turns
keeps the simulation STOP control available
